first_public_date_evidence: RAIRO Operations Research, volume 56 number 5, publisher issue contents: Edge open packing sets in graphs, DOI 10.1051/ro/2022171, explicitly Published online: 01 November 2022; https://www.rairo-ro.org/articles/ro/abs/2022/05/contents/contents.html.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact theorem only for \(GP(n,2)\) with integer \(n\ge5\); no general-k assertion and no census of all optimal packings. A reproducible finite integer certificate, proof of its implication, and constructive concatenation are supplied. Closely related published bounds and the Petersen boundary case are acknowledged. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Edge-open packings in generalized Petersen graphs \(GP(n,2)\): an exact nine-periodic law
